scope.train: 1 locomotive +4 empty cargo wagons; normal quality; nuclear fuel; braking1..7
scope.demand: 12 non-U-turn OD, uniform near/straight/far; independent FIFO at each incoming bank
scope.physics: native train physics, pathfinder, signals and collisions; no speed writes or teleports
scope.primary_metric: finite saturated full-train completions per game minute, not proven maximum stable service rate
scope.area_metric: AABB of native transformed primary and secondary entity boxes, including all candidate adapters, buffers and elevation projection; common fixture excluded

definitions: Geometries are exact rail, ramp and support layouts modulo translation, excluding signals and circuit/power entities; not abstract graph isomorphism classes.
Configurations include signals; labels and entity numbering do not count as changes.
Only native exit_code0 with final result is a completed experiment.
Unchanged IDs with changed bytes are reported and cannot silently inherit previous test evidence.
No mixed-bank, mixed-window or mixed-scenario aggregate should be ranked.

holdout_protocol.reason: Large new geometry has longer travel time and more internal train storage. Use2min warmup and4min measurement on fresh predeclared seeds, with larger preloaded bank, paired old reference. Do not pool with bank150/1+3minute selection group.
holdout_protocol.primary_endpoint: paired difference in completed full1+4 trains per game minute, provided all12OD receive service, no rolling-stock damage and every source retains never-entered bank throughout measurement.
secondary_diagnostics: internal unfinished trains at warmup and end

W_open_destination_cohort_delays.cohort_definition: Every requested train whose destination is not W, including unaffected preclosure completions; identical logical IDs in open and closed runs. Negative differences retained.
Every requested train whose destination is not W, including unaffected preclosure completions; identical logical IDs in open and closed runs. Negative differences retained.

all_exits_recovery.claims: Finite native observation; no maximum-capacity or deadlock-free proof; no CPU timing.
all_exits_recovery.interpretation: Finite all-exit closure and recovery gate; does not prove no deadlock for every future demand.

limits: Selection and holdout have different bank sizes/windows and are never pooled.
Small paired seed samples; observed gain is not global optimality or an asymptotic capacity estimate.
Only uniform mixed-OD throughput is independently confirmed in this round; biased mixes, loaded cargo, other train lengths and rotated layouts need future paired testing.
Completed-cohort transit excludes outstanding trains; inventory and OD gaps are reported separately.
Three-way forks, geometry, buffering and signals change together; no single-factor causal gain is claimed.
Native selected-path block DAG and finite closure recovery do not prove all-demand deadlock freedom.
CPU uses a separate common lower offered load and three identical-save repetitions, not saturated-bank CPU.
Distinct rail geometries/configurations are not a count of nonisomorphic abstract topology families.
